justification: Docs-only change: adds the Phase 2 deep-dive companion to the Phase 0+1 market scan under docs/. No code paths, no user-facing product surfaces, no database interaction, no build inputs touched. Zero .py/.ts/.tsx files in the diff vs origin/main.

break_it.scenario: A reader treats an [INFERENCE] or [UNVERIFIED] tagged claim in the market scan as verified fact and makes a domain-selection decision on it.
break_it.what_happens: A go/no-go call could rest on an unconfirmed figure (e.g. fractional-DPO population estimate, FSANZ labelling-slice page counts, revenue scenarios which are all inference).
break_it.how: Every unverified claim is tagged inline and consolidated in each report's Honesty Ledger; the Phase 2 verdict is explicitly conditioned on 5 buyer-conversation questions and carries flip criteria, so no build decision rests on untested claims.

post_merge.db_reset: N/A - no database objects touched; markdown documents only.
post_merge.secrets: N/A - no credentials, endpoints, or env vars referenced; the documents contain only public URLs.
post_merge.other_repo: N/A - single-repo change, no cross-repo dependencies.
post_merge.manual_verify: Open docs/rules-engine-market-scan-phase2.md on the branch and confirm it renders as GitHub markdown (the deep-dive tables are the only complex elements).
